messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Examples of CYP2B6 inhibitors include ticlopidine or clopidogrel.
Bupropion inhibits CYP2D6.
Bupropion can increase concentrations of antidepressants.
Examples of antidepressants include venlafaxine, nortriptyline, imipramine, desipramine, paroxetine, fluoxetine, and sertraline.
Bupropion can increase concentrations of antipsychotics.
Examples of antipsychotics include haloperidol, risperidone, and thioridazine.
Bupropion can increase concentrations of beta-blockers.
An example of a beta-blocker is metoprolol.
Bupropion can increase concentrations of Type 1C antiarrhythmics.
Examples of Type 1C antiarrhythmics include propafenone and flecainide.
These medicines are metabolized by CYP2D6.
A dose reduction of antidepressants may be considered when used with bupropion.
Dopaminergic drugs (levodopa and amantadine): CNS toxicity can occur when used concomitantly with Bupropion.
Not all possible interactions are listed in this medication guide.
Triplet: ["antidepressants", "has dosage adjustment recommendation", "dose reduction when used with Bupropion"]

The relation 'has dosage adjustment recommendation' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug or drug class may require a specific dosage adjustment as specified by the object entity when used in combination with another drug.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has dose adjustment instruction': The subject drug may require changes in dosage based on the condition or factor specified in the object entity.
B. 'may be prescribed with': The subject drug may be prescribed in combination with the medication specified by the object entity.
C. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
D. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
E. 'includes': The subject drug class or category includes the specific drug or entity specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
